text_en: There was a man living in Babylon whose name was Joakim.
text_cn: 从前有一个人住在巴比伦，名叫约雅金，

text_en: He married the daughter of Hilkiah, named Susanna, a very beautiful woman and one who feared the Lord.
text_cn: 他娶了一个妻子名叫苏撒纳，是希耳克雅的女儿；这女子非常美丽，而且敬畏上主，

text_en: Her parents were righteous, and had trained their daughter according to the law of Moses.
text_cn: 原来她的父母都是义人，常按照梅瑟的法律教育了自己的女儿。

text_en: Joakim was very rich, and had a fine garden adjoining his house; the Jews used to come to him because he was the most honored of them all.
text_cn: 约雅金是个很富有的人；靠近他的住宅有一个果园；由于他比众人更有声望，犹太人经常到他那里集会。

text_en: That year two elders from the people were appointed as judges. Concerning them the Lord had said: “Wickedness came forth from Babylon, from elders who were judges, who were supposed to govern the people. ”
text_cn: 那一年，有两个长老由人民选为民长，上主曾论及这类人说：“邪恶充塞巴比伦，是由于只在表面上治理人民的长老和民长。”

text_en: These men were frequently at Joakim’s house, and all who had a case to be tried came to them there.
text_cn: 这两个人经常到约雅金的家里来；凡有诉讼的，都到这里来见他们。

text_en: When the people left at noon, Susanna would go into her husband’s garden to walk.
text_cn: 中午时，人民离去以后，苏撒纳常走进她丈夫的果园里散步。

text_en: Every day the two elders used to see her, going in and walking about, and they began to lust for her.
text_cn: 那两个长老每天见她进去散步，遂对她起了邪念。

text_en: They suppressed their consciences and turned away their eyes from looking to Heaven or remembering their duty to administer justice.
text_cn: 他们昧着良心，转眼不看上天，全不思念正义的裁判。

text_en: Both were overwhelmed with passion for her, but they did not tell each other of their distress,
text_cn: 他们二人虽然都为了暗恋她而伤感，却不敢彼此披露自己的隐情，

text_en: for they were ashamed to disclose their lustful desire to seduce her.
text_cn: 因为他们都羞于说明自己希望与她交合的欲念。

text_en: Day after day they watched eagerly to see her.
text_cn: 但他们二人仍然天天争着去窥看她。

text_en: One day they said to each other, “Let us go home, for it is time for lunch. ” So they both left and parted from each other.
text_cn: 一天，这人对那人说：“我们现在回家吧，因为已到午饭的时候了。”他们出去以后，便各自走了。

text_en: But turning back, they met again; and when each pressed the other for the reason, they confessed their lust. Then together they arranged for a time when they could find her alone.
text_cn: 接着又都走回原来的地方，他们互问走回来的原因之后，便都承认了自己的欲念；于是他们二人同谋，寻找一个能遇到苏撒纳一人独处的时机。

text_en: Once, while they were watching for an opportune day, she went in as before with only two maids, and wished to bathe in the garden, for it was a hot day.
text_cn: 他们在等待一个适当的机会时，有一天苏撒纳像往日一样，只带着两个婢女进了果园，由于天热，她想在园中沐浴。

text_en: No one was there except the two elders, who had hidden themselves and were watching her.
text_cn: 那时园中除了这两个藏着窥看她的长老外，没有别人。

text_en: She said to her maids, “Bring me olive oil and ointments, and shut the garden doors so that I can bathe. ”
text_cn: 苏撒纳对婢女说：“将油和香皂给我拿来，关上园门，我要沐浴。”

text_en: They did as she told them: they shut the doors of the garden and went out by the side doors to bring what they had been commanded; they did not see the elders, because they were hiding.
text_cn: 她们便遵命去作，关上园门，从侧门出去，去取她吩咐她们的东西，全不知道这两个长老隐藏在那里。

text_en: When the maids had gone out, the two elders got up and ran to her.
text_cn: 婢女们一走出去，这两个长老便起来，跑到她面前，

text_en: They said, “Look, the garden doors are shut, and no one can see us. We are burning with desire for you; so give your consent, and lie with us.
text_cn: 对她说：“看，园门关了，没有人能看见我们，我们早就爱上了你，你要答应我们，与我们交合吧！

text_en: If you refuse, we will testify against you that a young man was with you, and this was why you sent your maids away. ”
text_cn: 不然，我们就要作证控告你，说有一个青年人同你在一起，所以你才打发婢女们离开你。”

text_en: Susanna groaned and said, “I am completely trapped. For if I do this, it will mean death for me; if I do not, I cannot escape your hands.
text_cn: 苏撒纳叹息说：“我真是左右为难！因为我若作了这事，我是必死无疑；我若不作这事，我也难逃你们的手。

text_en: I choose not to do it; I will fall into your hands, rather than sin in the sight of the Lord. ”
text_cn: 我不如不作，宁可落在你们手里，也不愿在上主面前犯罪。

text_en: Then Susanna cried out with a loud voice, and the two elders shouted against her.
text_cn: 苏撒纳遂高声喊叫，这两个长老为对付她也喊叫起来，

text_en: And one of them ran and opened the garden doors.
text_cn: 其中一个跑去开了园门。

text_en: When the people in the house heard the shouting in the garden, they rushed in at the side door to see what had happened to her.
text_cn: 家人一听见园中的喊声，就急忙从侧门跑进来，要看看她遭遇了什么事。

text_en: And when the elders told their story, the servants felt very much ashamed, for nothing like this had ever been said about Susanna.
text_cn: 但是当长老们说出这段话以后，仆人们都感觉羞惭，因为从来没有人说苏撒纳有过这样的事。

text_en: The next day, when the people gathered at the house of her husband Joakim, the two elders came, full of their wicked plot to have Susanna put to death. In the presence of the people they said,
text_cn: 第二天，人民聚集到她丈夫约雅金那里的时候，那两个长老也来了，满怀恶意，一心要将苏撒纳置于死地。

text_en: “Send for Susanna daughter of Hilkiah, the wife of Joakim. ”
text_cn: 他们在人民面前说：“派人将希耳克雅的女儿，约雅金的妻子，苏撒纳带上来！”差人便去了。

text_en: So they sent for her. And she came with her parents, her children, and all her relatives.
text_cn: 苏撒纳同他的父母，她的孩子和她所有的亲戚都来了。

text_en: Now Susanna was a woman of great refinement and beautiful in appearance.
text_cn: 苏撒纳长得体态轻盈，相貌美丽。

text_en: As she was veiled, the scoundrels ordered her to be unveiled, so that they might feast their eyes on her beauty.
text_cn: 这两个坏人命她除去面纱──因为她原是带着面纱的──好让自己饱览她的美色。

text_en: Those who were with her and all who saw her were weeping.
text_cn: 她的亲友和看见她的人都在哭泣。

text_en: Then the two elders stood up before the people and laid their hands on her head.
text_cn: 那两个长老遂在人民中站起来，把手按在苏撒纳的头上。

text_en: Through her tears she looked up toward Heaven, for her heart trusted in the Lord.
text_cn: 她哭着仰视上天，衷心依赖上主。

text_en: The elders said, “While we were walking in the garden alone, this woman came in with two maids, shut the garden doors, and dismissed the maids.
text_cn: 两个长老说：“当时只有我们两人在园中散步，她同两个婢女进来，随即关了园门，并辞退了两个婢女。

text_en: Then a young man, who was hiding there, came to her and lay with her.
text_cn: 一个预先藏在园中的青年人，走到她面前，与她睡在一起。

text_en: We were in a corner of the garden, and when we saw this wickedness we ran to them.
text_cn: 我们在园中的角落里看见这种丑事，便跑到他们那里。

text_en: Although we saw them embracing, we could not hold the man, because he was stronger than we, and he opened the doors and got away.
text_cn: 我们虽然看见他们二人在一起，但我们却不能捉住那个青年，因为他比我们有力，他便开门逃走了。

text_en: We did, however, seize this woman and asked who the young man was,
text_cn: 我们捉住这女人以后，问她那个青年是谁，

text_en: but she would not tell us. These things we testify. ” Because they were elders of the people and judges, the assembly believed them and condemned her to death.
text_cn: 她却不肯告诉我们：对于这些事，我们是见证。”会众相信了他们，因为他们是人民的长老和民长，于是便定了苏撒纳的死罪。

text_en: Then Susanna cried out with a loud voice, and said, “O eternal God, you know what is secret and are aware of all things before they come to be;
text_cn: 苏撒纳遂大声呼号说：“永生的天主！你洞察隐秘的事，凡事在发生以前，你已知道了；

text_en: you know that these men have given false evidence against me. And now I am to die, though I have done none of the wicked things that they have charged against me! ”
text_cn: 你知道他们对我所作的是假见证；看，现在我要死了，然而我并没有作过，他们恶意对我所捏造的事。”

text_en: The Lord heard her cry.
text_cn: 上主俯听了她的呼声；

text_en: Just as she was being led off to execution, God stirred up the holy spirit of a young lad named Daniel,
text_cn: 当她被押赴刑场的时候，天主感动了一个青年人的圣善心灵，这青年名叫达尼尔，

text_en: and he shouted with a loud voice, “I want no part in shedding this woman’s blood! ”
text_cn: 他便高声呼喊说：“对于流这女人的血，我是没有罪的！”

text_en: All the people turned to him and asked, “What is this you are saying? ”
text_cn: 民众转过身来问他说：“你说这话有什么意思呢？”

text_en: Taking his stand among them he said, “Are you such fools, O Israelites, as to condemn a daughter of Israel without examination and without learning the facts?
text_cn: 达尼尔立在民众中间说：“以色列子民！你们怎么这样糊涂？未经审问，不查实情，就定一个以色列女子的罪案吗？

text_en: Return to court, for these men have given false evidence against her. ”
text_cn: 你们再回审判厅！因为他们二人作了假见证，诬陷了她。”

text_en: So all the people hurried back. And the rest of the elders said to him, “Come, sit among us and inform us, for God has given you the standing of an elder. ”
text_cn: 于是民众急忙回去，众长老对达尼尔说：“请你来，坐在我们中间，明白地告诉我们，因为天主把长老的智慧赐给了你。”

text_en: Daniel said to them, “Separate them far from each other, and I will examine them. ”
text_cn: 达尼尔对他们说：“将这两个长老隔离开，让我来审问他们。”

text_en: When they were separated from each other, he summoned one of them and said to him, “You old relic of wicked days, your sins have now come home, which you have committed in the past,
text_cn: 把他们二人隔开以后，达尼尔叫过其中的一个来，对他说：“你这个一生作恶的老妖，你以前犯的罪，现在已临到你身上了！

text_en: pronouncing unjust judgments, condemning the innocent and acquitting the guilty, though the Lord said, ‘You shall not put an innocent and righteous person to death. ’
text_cn: 你宣布不义的裁判，判定无辜者有罪，释放有罪的人，虽然上主曾说：不可杀害无辜和正义的人。

text_en: Now then, if you really saw this woman, tell me this: Under what tree did you see them being intimate with each other? ” He answered, “Under a mastic tree. ”
text_cn: 如果你真看见了她，现在你告诉我：你看见他们在一起是在什么树下？”他回答说：“是在乳香树下。”

text_en: And Daniel said, “Very well! This lie has cost you your head, for the angel of God has received the sentence from God and will immediately cut you in two. ”
text_cn: 达尼尔说：“够了！你在说谎，应砍你的头，因为天主的天使已奉天主的命，要把你斩为两段。”

text_en: Then, putting him to one side, he ordered them to bring the other. And he said to him, “You offspring of Canaan and not of Judah, beauty has beguiled you and lust has perverted your heart.
text_cn: 达尼尔叫他退下，命将另一个带上来，对他说：“客纳罕的苗裔而非犹大的苗裔啊！美色迷惑了你，淫欲颠倒了你的心。

text_en: This is how you have been treating the daughters of Israel, and they were intimate with you through fear; but a daughter of Judah would not tolerate your wickedness.
text_cn: 你们一向这样对待了以色列的女子们，她们由于害怕而与你们交往，但是这个犹大女子，却不能忍受你们的邪恶！

text_en: Now then, tell me: Under what tree did you catch them being intimate with each other? ” He answered, “Under an evergreen oak. ”
text_cn: 现在你告诉我：你发现他们在一起，是在什么树下？”他回答说：“是在樟树下。”

text_en: Daniel said to him, “Very well! This lie has cost you also your head, for the angel of God is waiting with his sword to split you in two, so as to destroy you both. ”
text_cn: 达尼尔对他说：“的确，你也一样在说谎话，也必要砍下你的头！天主的天使手中已拿了利剑在等待着，要将你斩为两段，消灭你们。”

text_en: Then the whole assembly raised a great shout and blessed God, who saves those who hope in him.
text_cn: 全会众遂大声呐喊，赞美天主，因为他拯救了那些仰望他的人。

text_en: And they took action against the two elders, because out of their own mouths Daniel had convicted them of bearing false witness; they did to them as they had wickedly planned to do to their neighbor.
text_cn: 众人都起来攻击那两个长老，因为达尼尔按照他们二人的口供，证实了他们作假见证；他们怎样恶意对待了自己的近人，民众也怎样对待了他们。

text_en: Acting in accordance with the law of Moses, they put them to death. Thus innocent blood was spared that day.
text_cn: 于是众人按照梅瑟的法律将他们处死；这样，那一天救了无辜者的血。

text_en: Hilkiah and his wife praised God for their daughter Susanna, and so did her husband Joakim and all her relatives, because she was found innocent of a shameful deed.
text_cn: 为此，希耳克雅和他的妻子为女儿苏撒纳，同苏撒纳的丈夫约雅金和自己全体亲友，一起称谢了天主，因为在苏撒纳身上没有找到什么败德的事。

text_en: And from that day onward Daniel had a great reputation among the people.
text_cn: 从那一天以后，达尼尔在人民面前大受尊重。
